text.en:
This Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 27th day of August, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-one, and
of the Independence of the Philippines, the sixth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Assistant Vicecutive Secretary
